card.name: The verb make in "make it" (arrive)
card.fires_on: The verb make/made/making when it means to reach or get to a place or stage, as in "made it to the surface" or "make it to adulthood". Also fires on similar verbs in "strike it rich".

modes.label: Make it to a destination
modes.description: Make in the sense of arriving or surviving to reach a place or stage, usually followed by "it" or "to".
modes.example: the parasite proteins never<< made>> it to the surface of the cells.

modes.label: Make a journey or list
modes.description: Make followed by a noun like journey, way or final draft, meaning to get there or be included.
modes.example: Forty-eight hatchlings<< made>> their way to the water that morning,

card.plain: It marks the verb "make" when it means to reach or get through, just before the word "it".
